annotations.title: Turn Widget Pinning on or off

description: Freeze the chat widget at its current version, so the site always serves the same copy with an integrity hash. Turning it on builds that snapshot and changes the embed code. Needs the Enterprise plan.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.
